items.name: Pump shotgun
items.description: Unbranded 12-gauge hunting pump. Four shells in the exported tube, plus one chambered. Hold R to load loose shells; double-press R to rack; tap, then hold R to keep racking it empty; a single tap does nothing. Wield and activate a sealed shell box to unpack it first. LMB fires once; rack before the next shot. Empty mass and 2x8 inventory size are gameplay estimates, fitting ordinary backpack/pile handling.

items.name: Pump shotgun (debug)
items.description: Curated 12-gauge hunting-cabin pump from gungen, with a hand-racked action and four-shell tube. No loot table has it; spawn it with G (?debug=1). Runtime pumping/loading is not implemented yet.

items.name: AR-pattern rifle
items.description: A curated gungen AR in 5.56×45, fed from STANAG magazines. Hold R to change to the fullest carried magazine; double-press R to work the charging handle; tap, then hold R to remove the magazine. LMB fires; hold it for automatic fire. Prototype gameplay mass: 3500 g, not a sourced firearm specification.

items.name: AK-pattern rifle
items.description: A curated gungen AK in 7.62×39, fed from AKM magazines, with its handle on the carrier. Hold R to change to the fullest carried magazine; double-press R to work the charging handle; tap, then hold R to remove the magazine. LMB fires; hold it for automatic fire. Prototype gameplay mass: 3500 g, not a sourced firearm specification.
